candidate.title: hiCLIP
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina hiCLIP schematic: RBP-bound RNA duplex capture, partial digestion, immunoprecipitation, two-adaptor ligation with selective linker unblocking, inter-arm joining, protein removal, sequencing and same-RNA/different-RNA mapping outcomes. The primary STAU1 hiCLIP paper resolves end chemistry and the compressed RNA-to-cDNA sequencing interface. This is a schematic architecture, not the complete STAU1 experimental protocol or a claim that every RBP implementation performs identically.
